intro: More than a table, Jack’s where stories unfold. With a natural veneer, ultra-comfy chairs & solid wood legs, it makes gathering feel effortless.

features.title: Premium veneer for timeless style
features.text: The Okoume veneer finish brings rich, natural texture to your dining space, blending beauty with everyday durability.

features.title: Strong wood legs for sturdy support
features.text: Solid wood L-shaped legs provide stability & unique design, making the table a statement piece that stands strong.

features.title: Cushioned chairs for ultimate comfort
features.text: Soft padding on both seat & back keeps every meal comfortable — perfect for long conversations after dinner.

features.title: Solid wood construction for lasting use
features.text: Built with solid rubber wood, our chairs are strong, stable & made to handle years of daily dining.

features.title: Seamless fit with warm interiors
features.text: The rich brownish-black finish pairs easily with modern, rustic or transitional décor, making styling effortless.

features.title: Perfectly sized for six
features.text: With room for six, our design offers the ideal space for family dinners, celebrations or cosy weekend brunches.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
